description: This procedure implements single-shot, group-aware, specimen-held-out spike rate inference for OGB-1 zebrafish data. It performs group-k-fold cross-validation on training specimens, trains a pipeline on full training data, and predicts for held-out test animals. Each input recording is handled independently; no resampling, no cross-record smoothing. The method constructs a compact sequence of steps: per-record Z-score normalization (mask-aware), extraction of per-record statistics, linear regression with group-k-fold cross-validation grouped by train specimen, and a nonnegativity constraint enforced post-prediction. Padding/invalid frames (channel 1 mask == 0) are handled carefully: normalization, model fitting and loss computation are restricted to valid frames; training targets with value -1 are excluded. Standard errors are returned for every step. Deterministic seed ensures fixed splits and reproducibility.
